calendarNotes: San Juan Unified starts the 2026-2027 school year on August 13, 2026 and ends on June 8, 2027. The official student calendar lists Labor Day, October 5 no school, Veterans Day, November 12-13 no school, Thanksgiving Break from November 23-27, Winter Break from December 21-January 4, Presidents' Week Break from February 15-19, Spring Break from March 22-26, April 23 no school, Memorial Day, and translated student calendar PDFs in several languages.

calendarFaqs.q: When does San Juan Unified start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: San Juan Unified starts school on Thursday, August 13, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is San Juan Unified Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is San Juan Unified Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Monday, January 4, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is San Juan Unified Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for San Juan Unified in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Tuesday, June 8, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Does San Juan Unified publish translated 2026-2027 calendars?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. San Juan Unified publishes 2026-2027 student calendar PDFs in Arabic, Pashto, Persian, Russian, Spanish, and Ukrainian in addition to English.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the San Juan Unified calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the San Juan Unified ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

calendarFaqs.q: How many school days are in San Juan Unified 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The San Juan Unified 2026-2027 student calendar includes 180 instructional days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does San Juan Unified have school on holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. San Juan Unified does not hold regular student attendance on listed holidays such as Labor Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving Day, Memorial Day, and other student holidays on the official calendar. Families should also check no-school days and recess periods separately.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the San Juan Unified calendar change after publication?
calendarFaqs.a: Calendar dates can change after publication because of revisions, emergency closures, campus-specific events, or district announcements. The official San Juan Unified calendar page remains the source of record for final updates.

customSections.label: San Juan Unified Calendar Questions Parents Ask Before Planning
customSections.content: These parent planning questions are not a substitute for official San Juan Unified announcements. They explain how families commonly use the student calendar before arranging childcare, travel, school transportation, and campus-specific schedules.

rows: Can students attend school during teacher work days?

Teacher work days and staff development days are not regular student attendance days when they appear as no-school dates on the official student calendar. Use campus announcements for office hours, activities, or program-specific exceptions.
Are all San Juan Unified schools closed during breaks?
Districtwide breaks apply to the student calendar, but school programs, athletics, childcare, and campus events may publish separate schedules. Confirm details with the student's assigned school.
Should I use the PDF or ICS calendar?
Use the official PDF as the source reference for verified dates. Use the ICS file for a one-time personal calendar import into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.
Does the calendar include minimum days?
This page summarizes the official student calendar. If a minimum day or shortened schedule affects pickup time, confirm the bell schedule with the student's school before making plans.

groups.label: Before long breaks
items: Arrange childcare before Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Presidents' Week Break, and Spring Break.
Review medication, meal, and transportation plans before full-week recess periods.
Confirm travel plans against the official San Juan Unified calendar before booking nonrefundable reservations.

groups.label: Before summer
items: Use June 8, 2027 as the last-day planning anchor for summer programs and family travel.
Watch for report card, promotion, graduation, and campus-specific end-of-year announcements.
Verify any enrollment changes or program transitions directly with San Juan Unified or the student's school.

customSections.label: How We Verify San Juan Unified Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official San Juan Unified calendar page and student calendar PDFs, then compares key dates such as first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Presidents' Week Break, Spring Break, holidays, no-school days, local holidays, and translated calendar links before converting the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official San Juan Unified calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
